limits: Execution conditions fixed before this study. All offsets and failures are retained; no seed is selected for a success narrative.
The repetition probe withdraws after the first protected boundary in the trial; this is not a claim that the unfinished case has been solved.
The power probe grants 8 points and C access only as controlled comparison fixtures. It is not naturally earned progression.
Initial deck, actor HP/posture, rewards, skill effects, costs, and public action policies are inherited unchanged from AM. No new cap, equipment slot, point loss, or stage unlock is implemented.
The 16 seed offsets reuse the existing AM seed bank. They are deterministic sensitivity cases, not statistically independent samples, held-out validation, optimal players, or human play.
Analysis of AM journey-results reads the frozen prior experiment; it is not a newly executed natural route comparison.
All-learned outcomes evaluate only four existing trial effects. They cannot establish endgame balance or the fun of permanent skill exclusion.
